The Apache Tomcat Manager application provides an HTTP text interface for deploying, managing, and monitoring Java web applications. Includes application lifecycle management (deploy, start, stop, reload, undeploy), session management, server status, diagnostics (thread dumps, VM info, memory leak detection), SSL/TLS management, JMX proxy access, and configuration persistence.
